text:
Predicates:
Published(x, y) ::: x is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
English(x) ::: x is an English book.
Italian(x) ::: x is an Italian book.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Press(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializesIn(x, y) ::: x specializes in translating y.
Premises:
Press(NewVesselPress) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house.
∀x (Published(x, y) → English(x)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
Published(neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Published(palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
English(neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
